items.label: 【Kid & Senior-Friendly Gift Phone
items.value: Affordable & Easy-to-Use】：The perfect gift for kids or seniors! With intuitive controls and no complicated features, it’s a breeze to make calls and stay connected. Budget-friendly pricing means no stress over accidental drops, scratches, or loss—giving loved ones independence while you stay worry-free.

items: 【Dual SIM Global Unlocked | US Major Carriers Compatible】：Stay connected worldwide—use dual SIM to separate work/personal lines, or travel overseas without extra fees. Fully compatible with top US carriers including AT&T, T-Mobile, Boost Mobile, Metro by T-Mobile and Mint Mobile.

【Ultra-Light 6.42oz (182g) Backup Phone】：At just 6.42oz (182g), this ultra-portable phone fits easily in pockets, purses, or travel bags—no extra bulk! Perfect as a backup device for travel, business trips, or daily use, keeping you connected without weighing you down.

【256GB Expandable Storage】：2GB RAM + 32GB built-in storage, expandable up to 256GB via microSD! Perfect for seniors/kids to snap photos without deleting favorites, and professionals to store work files—no more worrying about running out of space. Ample room for memories, docs, and more, fitting the whole family’s needs.

【Pre-Pasted Screen Protector + After-Sales Support】：Ready to use right out of the box—no tedious screen protector installation! Plus, reliable after-sales service gives you peace of mind. Perfect for seniors, kids, or anyone wanting hassle-free setup and support for their new phone.
